const IMAGES = {"basophil": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "ct_dense_irregular": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "ct_dense_regular": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "ct_elastic": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "ct_fat": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "ct_loose": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "ct_mesenchymal": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "ct_mucosal": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "ct_reticular": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "eosinophil": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "erythrocyte": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "lymphnode_cortex": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "lymphocyte": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "malt_appendix": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "monocyte": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "neutrophil": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "platelet": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "pseudostrat_epididymis": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "pseudostrat_trachea": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "sc_columnar_intestine": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "sc_thyroid": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "spleen_pulp": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "ss_bowmans": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "ssq_esophagus": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "ssq_skin": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "strat_columnar_urethra": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "strat_cuboidal_ovary": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "thymus_lobule": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "thymus_medulla": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "transitional_bladder": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "fibroblast": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "plasmacell": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "macrophage": "data:image/jpeg;base64,", "mastcell": "data:image/jpeg;base64,"};

(function () {
  'use strict';

  const el = id => document.getElementById(id);

  const state = {
    QUESTIONS: [],
    current: 0,
    score: 0,
    answered: false,
    hintUsed: false,
    log: [], // {q, status: 'correct'|'wrong'|'skipped', userAnswer, hintUsed}
    catStats: {},
    kindStats: {}, // breakdown by Type / Name / Distribution / Function
    reviewFilter: 'all'
  };

  function shuffleArray(arr) {
    const a = arr.slice();
    for (let i = a.length - 1; i > 0; i--) {
      const j = Math.floor(Math.random() * (i + 1));
      [a[i], a[j]] = [a[j], a[i]];
    }
    return a;
  }

  function normalize(s) {
    return s.toLowerCase()
      .normalize('NFD').replace(/[\u0300-\u036f]/g, '')
      .replace(/[.,\/#!$%\^&\*;:{}=\-_`~()±'"]/g, '')
      .replace(/\s+/g, ' ')
      .trim();
  }

  // Classic Levenshtein edit distance, used to forgive small typos/pluralization.
  function levenshtein(a, b) {
    if (a === b) return 0;
    const al = a.length, bl = b.length;
    if (al === 0) return bl;
    if (bl === 0) return al;
    let prev = new Array(bl + 1);
    let curr = new Array(bl + 1);
    for (let j = 0; j <= bl; j++) prev[j] = j;
    for (let i = 1; i <= al; i++) {
      curr[0] = i;
      for (let j = 1; j <= bl; j++) {
        const cost = a[i - 1] === b[j - 1] ? 0 : 1;
        curr[j] = Math.min(
          prev[j] + 1,       // deletion
          curr[j - 1] + 1,   // insertion
          prev[j - 1] + cost // substitution
        );
      }
      const tmp = prev; prev = curr; curr = tmp;
    }
    return prev[bl];
  }

  // Loosely compares a normalized user token to a normalized accepted token,
  // tolerating small typos/pluralization proportional to word length.
  function fuzzyTokenMatch(norm, na) {
    if (!na) return false;
    if (norm === na) return true;
    if (na.length >= 3 && (norm.includes(na) || na.includes(norm))) return true;
    const maxLen = Math.max(norm.length, na.length);
    const tolerance = maxLen <= 4 ? 1 : (maxLen <= 9 ? 2 : 3);
    return levenshtein(norm, na) <= tolerance;
  }

  function checkAnswer(userText, acceptedList) {
    const norm = normalize(userText);
    if (!norm) return false;
    const normWords = norm.split(' ');
    for (const acc of acceptedList) {
      const na = normalize(acc);
      if (!na) continue;
      if (fuzzyTokenMatch(norm, na)) return true;
      // For multi-word accepted answers, allow each word to independently
      // tolerate a small typo (e.g. "red bloood cell" -> "red blood cell").
      const naWords = na.split(' ');
      if (naWords.length > 1 && naWords.length === normWords.length) {
        let allClose = true;
        for (let i = 0; i < naWords.length; i++) {
          if (!fuzzyTokenMatch(normWords[i], naWords[i])) { allClose = false; break; }
        }
        if (allClose) return true;
      }
    }
    return false;
  }

  function startQuiz() {
    el('screen-start').classList.add('hidden');
    el('screen-result').classList.add('hidden');
    el('screen-review').classList.add('hidden');
    el('screen-quiz').classList.remove('hidden');
    state.QUESTIONS = shuffleArray(ALL_QUESTIONS);
    state.current = 0;
    state.score = 0;
    state.answered = false;
    state.hintUsed = false;
    state.log = [];
    state.catStats = {};
    state.kindStats = {};
    state.QUESTIONS.forEach(q => {
      if (!state.catStats[q.category]) state.catStats[q.category] = { correct: 0, total: 0 };
      state.catStats[q.category].total++;
      if (!state.kindStats[q.qkind]) state.kindStats[q.qkind] = { correct: 0, total: 0 };
      state.kindStats[q.qkind].total++;
    });
    renderQuestion();
  }

  function renderQuestion() {
    state.answered = false;
    state.hintUsed = false;
    const q = state.QUESTIONS[state.current];
    el('progress-text').textContent = (state.current + 1) + ' / ' + state.QUESTIONS.length;
    el('progress-fill').style.width = ((state.current) / state.QUESTIONS.length * 100) + '%';
    el('cat-badge').textContent = q.category + ' · ' + q.qkind;

    const img = el('qimg');
    img.src = IMAGES[q.img];
    // Dynamic but vague alt text: descriptive of the category without giving away the answer.
    img.alt = 'Microscope view of an unknown ' + q.category.toLowerCase() + ' specimen';

    el('qtext').textContent = q.q;
    el('hint-box').classList.add('hidden');
    el('hint-box').textContent = '';
    el('btn-hint').disabled = false;
    el('btn-hint').innerHTML = '&#128161; Show Hint';

    const input = el('answer-input');
    input.value = '';
    input.className = 'answer-input';
    input.disabled = false;
    el('feedback-area').innerHTML = '';
    el('btn-submit').classList.remove('hidden');
    el('btn-next').classList.add('hidden');
    el('btn-skip').classList.remove('hidden');
    setTimeout(() => input.focus(), 50);
  }

  function showHint() {
    const q = state.QUESTIONS[state.current];
    state.hintUsed = true;
    el('hint-box').textContent = '💡 ' + q.hint;
    el('hint-box').classList.remove('hidden');
    el('btn-hint').disabled = true;
  }

  function submitAnswer(e) {
    if (e) e.preventDefault();
    if (state.answered) return false;
    const q = state.QUESTIONS[state.current];
    const input = el('answer-input');
    const userText = input.value;
    if (!userText.trim()) { input.focus(); return false; }
    finalizeAnswer(userText, checkAnswer(userText, q.answers), 'answered');
    return false;
  }

  function skipAnswer() {
    if (state.answered) return;
    finalizeAnswer('', false, 'skipped');
  }

  function finalizeAnswer(userText, isCorrect, mode) {
    state.answered = true;
    const q = state.QUESTIONS[state.current];
    const input = el('answer-input');
    input.disabled = true;
    el('btn-hint').disabled = true;

    let status;
    if (mode === 'skipped') {
      status = 'skipped';
      input.classList.add('wrong');
    } else if (isCorrect) {
      status = 'correct';
      input.classList.add('correct');
      state.score++;
      state.catStats[q.category].correct++;
      state.kindStats[q.qkind].correct++;
    } else {
      status = 'wrong';
      input.classList.add('wrong');
    }

    state.log.push({ q: q, status: status, userAnswer: userText, hintUsed: state.hintUsed });

    const feedbackArea = el('feedback-area');
    let tagHtml, extraLine = '';
    if (status === 'correct') {
      tagHtml = '<span class="feedback-tag correct">Correct!</span>';
    } else if (status === 'skipped') {
      tagHtml = '<span class="feedback-tag wrong">Skipped</span>';
      extraLine = '<div class="correct-answer-line"><b>Expected answer:</b> ' + q.answers[0] + '</div>';
    } else {
      tagHtml = '<span class="feedback-tag wrong">Not quite</span>';
      extraLine = '<div class="correct-answer-line"><b>Expected answer:</b> ' + q.answers[0] + '</div>';
    }
    feedbackArea.innerHTML =
      '<div style="text-align:center;">' + tagHtml + '</div>' +
      extraLine +
      '<div class="explain">' + q.explain + '</div>';

    el('btn-submit').classList.add('hidden');
    el('btn-skip').classList.add('hidden');
    el('btn-next').classList.remove('hidden');
    el('btn-next').textContent = (state.current === state.QUESTIONS.length - 1) ? 'See Results' : 'Next →';
    el('btn-next').focus();
  }

  function nextQuestion() {
    state.current++;
    if (state.current >= state.QUESTIONS.length) {
      showResult();
    } else {
      renderQuestion();
    }
  }

  function renderBreakdown(container, stats) {
    container.innerHTML = '';
    Object.keys(stats).forEach(key => {
      const s = stats[key];
      const p = s.total ? Math.round(s.correct / s.total * 100) : 0;
      const row = document.createElement('div');
      row.className = 'cat-row';
      row.innerHTML = '<span style="min-width:150px;">' + key + '</span>' +
        '<span class="cat-bar-bg"><span class="cat-bar-fill" style="width:' + p + '%;"></span></span>' +
        '<b>' + s.correct + '/' + s.total + '</b>';
      container.appendChild(row);
    });
  }

  function ensureKindBreakdownEl() {
    let kindBd = el('kind-breakdown');
    if (!kindBd) {
      const heading = document.createElement('div');
      heading.className = 'topline';
      heading.style.marginTop = '14px';
      heading.textContent = 'BY QUESTION TYPE';
      kindBd = document.createElement('div');
      kindBd.id = 'kind-breakdown';
      kindBd.className = 'cat-breakdown';
      const catBd = el('cat-breakdown');
      catBd.insertAdjacentElement('afterend', kindBd);
      catBd.insertAdjacentElement('afterend', heading);
    }
    return kindBd;
  }

  function showResult() {
    el('screen-quiz').classList.add('hidden');
    el('screen-review').classList.add('hidden');
    el('screen-result').classList.remove('hidden');
    el('score-big').textContent = state.score + ' / ' + state.QUESTIONS.length;
    const pct = Math.round(state.score / state.QUESTIONS.length * 100);
    let msg = '';
    if (pct >= 90) msg = 'Outstanding! Your histology eye is razor-sharp.';
    else if (pct >= 75) msg = 'Great job! Just a bit more to perfection.';
    else if (pct >= 50) msg = 'Not bad — take another look at the slide images.';
    else msg = 'Keep practicing recognizing these slide images!';
    el('score-sub').textContent = pct + '% correct — ' + msg;

    renderBreakdown(el('cat-breakdown'), state.catStats);
    // Extra breakdown by question kind (Type / Name / Distribution / Function), since
    // every image is quizzed on all four.
    renderBreakdown(ensureKindBreakdownEl(), state.kindStats);
  }

  function restartQuiz() {
    startQuiz();
  }

  function reviewAll() {
    el('screen-result').classList.add('hidden');
    el('screen-review').classList.remove('hidden');
    state.reviewFilter = 'all';
    updateFilterCounts();
    setFilter('all');
  }

  function updateFilterCounts() {
    const c = { all: state.log.length, wrong: 0, correct: 0, skipped: 0 };
    state.log.forEach(item => c[item.status]++);
    el('cnt-all').textContent = c.all;
    el('cnt-wrong').textContent = c.wrong;
    el('cnt-correct').textContent = c.correct;
    el('cnt-skipped').textContent = c.skipped;
  }

  function setFilter(f) {
    state.reviewFilter = f;
    ['all', 'wrong', 'correct', 'skipped'].forEach(k => {
      el('filter-' + k).classList.toggle('active', k === f);
    });
    renderReviewList();
  }

  function renderReviewList() {
    const list = el('review-list');
    list.innerHTML = '';
    const items = state.log.filter(item => state.reviewFilter === 'all' ? true : item.status === state.reviewFilter);
    if (items.length === 0) {
      list.innerHTML = '<p class="lead">Nothing to show here.</p>';
      return;
    }
    items.forEach(item => {
      const q = item.q;
      const div = document.createElement('div');
      div.className = 'review-item item-' + item.status;
      const statusLabel = item.status === 'correct' ? 'Correct' : (item.status === 'skipped' ? 'Skipped' : 'Wrong');
      const statusClass = item.status === 'correct' ? 'st-correct' : (item.status === 'skipped' ? 'st-skipped' : 'st-wrong');
      div.innerHTML =
        '<div class="review-head"><span class="review-status ' + statusClass + '">' + statusLabel + '</span>' +
        '<span class="review-cat">' + q.category + ' · ' + q.qkind + (item.hintUsed ? '<span class="hint-used-tag">hint used</span>' : '') + '</span></div>' +
        '<div style="text-align:center;margin-bottom:8px;"><img src="' + IMAGES[q.img] + '" alt="Microscope view of the ' + q.category.toLowerCase() + ' specimen from this question" style="max-width:55%;border-radius:8px;"></div>' +
        '<div style="font-weight:600;margin-bottom:6px;text-align:center;">' + q.q + '</div>' +
        (item.status !== 'correct' ? '<div style="font-size:13px;color:#7d2323;margin-bottom:4px;text-align:center;"><b>Your answer:</b> ' + (item.userAnswer || '(none)') + '</div>' : '') +
        '<div style="font-size:13px;color:#1e5c37;margin-bottom:4px;text-align:center;"><b>Expected answer:</b> ' + q.answers[0] + '</div>' +
        '<div class="explain" style="margin-top:6px;">' + q.explain + '</div>';
      list.appendChild(div);
    });
  }

  function bindEvents() {
    el('btn-start').addEventListener('click', startQuiz);
    el('btn-hint').addEventListener('click', showHint);
    el('answer-form').addEventListener('submit', submitAnswer);
    el('btn-submit').addEventListener('click', submitAnswer);
    el('btn-next').addEventListener('click', nextQuestion);
    el('btn-skip').addEventListener('click', skipAnswer);
    el('btn-restart').addEventListener('click', restartQuiz);
    el('btn-review-all').addEventListener('click', reviewAll);
    el('btn-back-to-results').addEventListener('click', showResult);
    ['all', 'wrong', 'correct', 'skipped'].forEach(k => {
      el('filter-' + k).addEventListener('click', () => setFilter(k));
    });
  }

  document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', bindEvents);
})();

</script>
</body>
</html>
